text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Looking at the morning sun always
brings back
memories...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Memories of that day... and what Dad
taught
me...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Bamboo! Someday, you'll have
a dream
too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Your dream will be like the sun, giving
you
strength and courage when you
need it most!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
The reason my rival and I were able to
face each
other time and time again was
because we both
had a dream that
connected us!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Your dream will help you grow and
mature,
bringing you some of your most
precious
encounters!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
But there's no rush! You don't need to
figure it
out now! You'll find it one day,
and it'll hit you
when you do!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'm gonna find my own dream one
day, just
like you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Okay, break time's up!
Time to
get that blood pumping again
with some more
red-hot early morning
training!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Yessir!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I'm finally doing it, Dad! I'm headed
toward my
dream!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ALL RIGHT!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Time to get pumped up! Let's start off
the day
with some disciplinary
committee work!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Burn bright, Bamboo Memory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory and I are finally ready
to
challenge the Twinkle Series in
earnest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to match Bamboo Memory's
fighting spirit
and passion if I'm going to
walk beside her! I pep
myself up and
head to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: GOOOOOD MORNING!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory greets the other
students with a
booming voice as they
arrive at the academy! I
guess this is part
of her duties as a disciplinary
committee
member.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Bamboo Memory!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely greeting! Good morning
to you
too! Have a great day!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
Hey, you! The one who just
yawned! Your bow is
askew!

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Student
text_block_list.text: Oof, sorry! I-I'll fix it right away!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A lax outfit leads to a lax mentality!
Straighten up
your collar! Get fired up!
Have a great day!

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Student
text_block_list.text: S-sure...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!
choice_data_list_en: Hard at work first thing in the morning, huh.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooh, nice greeting, Trainer! I like it!
choice_data_list: おはようございますっ！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah?! Me too! Just thinking about
all the
exciting days in front of us until
my debut has me
feeling electrified!
choice_data_list: 気合い入ってるからな
気合い入ってるからね

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
However! I'm going to stay on top of my

disciplinary committee duties until
training this
afternoon! This is also
important to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since we're going to be walking this
path
together, it's best if I learn as much
as I can about
Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I mean, of course... but why out of
the blue?
choice_data_list: せっかくだから風紀委員の仕事を見たいな
choice_data_list_en: Since I'm here, I'd like to see the Disciplinary Committee in action.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That's kind of embarrassing, but I
guess it
makes sense! Take a good look
and see what
being on the disciplinary
committee is all about!
choice_data_list: バンブーメモリーのことをもっと知りたくて
choice_data_list_en: I want to get to know Bamboo Memory better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bamboo Memory takes me
through her
disciplinary committee
duties.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You there! That's not where you recycle
plastic
bottles! Make sure you dispose of
your waste
properly!

text_block_list.name: Panicked Student
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I'll be more careful!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Stop! Look where you're going when
you're
running! You need to be aware of
your
surroundings at all times!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Student
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey! This is a public space! If you're
going to film
something for UmaTok,
please be careful!

text_block_list.name: Excited Student
text_block_list.text: Whoops! I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo's at it again today. I've been on
the
other end of that once and her voice
seemed so
loud. I was terrified.

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but she's really nice and takes her job seriously. She'll always rush right over if you need her... even if she is a little loud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While accompanying Bamboo Memory
on her
rounds, I overhear some chatter
about how she
can be quite strict, but
also very reliable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain it's an impression built on her

straightforward and ever-enthusiastic
personality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Bamboo Memory so devoted to
her
disciplinary committee duties makes
me want to
meet her candor with
sincerity and enthusiasm.
choice_data_list: （俺もトレーナーとして倣わないとだな）
（私もトレーナーとして倣わないとだね）
choice_data_list_en: (I should follow that example as a Trainer too.)
(As a Trainer, I should follow that example.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's time for our afternoon
training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh boy! It's finally time to start
training!
Let's do it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YEAH!
choice_data_list_en: Let's give it all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
On that note... I know it's a bit early still,
but is it
okay if I go ahead and run for a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've already warmed up, so I'll be okay!
My body
just won't stop tingling! Just
one lap and I should
be okay! Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems quite motivated, and I don't
want to
discourage her by making her
wait too long. So...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yesss! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll be back in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory takes off with
explosive
acceleration. As expected,
she's definitely got
something special!

text_block_list.name: Student in Tracksuit A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Isn't that the head of the
disciplinary
committee sprinting over
there? Look at her go!

text_block_list.name: Student in Tracksuit B
text_block_list.text:
Her voice is pretty impressive too!
Seeing that
kind of passion makes me
feel like I've gotta go
for it too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Such tremendous leg strength... And she
runs with
such vitality as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I won't be outdone.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm not finished yet! GRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an unexpected turn of events,
Bamboo
Memory's training kicks off with
a dead sprint
under clear skies.
choice_data_list_en: Just one lap, you hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And that's our first day DONE! Thanks,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Training just flew by! I can't believe it's
already
evening. Talk about a packed
regimen...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt in my mind! One day,
I'm gonna
have the ultimate showdown
with the ultimate
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sorry for startling you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Anytime I see a beautiful sunset or a
nice sunrise,
I just wanna shout out my
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mark my words! I'm going to pour in my
heart,
soul, and whatever else is
necessary to make this
dream come true!
Let's make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I've got an idea! Why don't you try
shouting
your dreams at the sunset too?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gaze into the sunset, take a deep
breath, and
give voice to my feelings
and my current dream...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
With Trainer by my side, I'm gonna
become the
strongest Umamusume! IT'S
A PROMISE!
choice_data_list: バンブーメモリーを強いウマ娘にするぞー！
choice_data_list_en: Let's turn Bamboo Memory into a powerhouse Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My time spent taking on fiery challenges
with
Bamboo Memory starts now!
